label: The mirror fork for a necessitarian and the contrast gap of every invariant source

(2) Under collapse, that possibility principle, factivity and reversed handedness, some essential truth holds at the actual world and fails at its mirror image. (7) Under a30c5963, RootPurity, the sufficiency direction of member grounding and 0c8631bd, two exclusive orientation tokens (real determinations) on a par in purity are had by no actual root. (8) If every actual concrete being is NECESSARY_2 and some actual concrete being exists at the mirror image only if that image has the actual handedness, then with factivity, preservation and reversed handedness, world-level essence-grounded possibility fails. (9) Under essence grounding necessity at w, essence-grounded possibility and factivity, preservation holds exactly when the mirror image is accessible. (10) With clause 7's premises and the open bridge that an orientation in the ESSENCE_5 nature of any being (roots included) is carried by an orientation token it really has, no ESSENCE_5 truth of an actual root holds at the actual world and fails at its mirror image.
